name: app.ship
description: App Studio SUB criterion for the ship-release stage: is this release record ready for Mike's Gate-D decision? Checks a local production build is cited, the target environment was audited, the release is held at Gate-D or carries an approval id, a post-release check on the real target is defined, a rollback exists, and mobile store policy items were checked. A PASS here is never permission to ship; it only means the Gate-D request is complete. ADVISORY AND UNCALIBRATED until calibrated.

prod_build_proof.instructions: A production build was run locally or in CI and its output (route count, exit code, artifact) is cited

env_audit.instructions: The environment variables the target needs were listed and checked, and any env change is followed by a redeploy without build cache

gate_d_recorded.instructions: The release step is held at Gate-D awaiting Mike, or carries a recorded approval id; nothing public happened silently

post_release_verify.instructions: A post-release check on the real target is defined: served page or asset hash changed, key routes return 200 with expected content, or the store build is visible

rollback_named.instructions: A rollback or previous-version path is named

store_policy.instructions: Either this is not a mobile app store release, or in-app account deletion, purchases that actually transact, metadata the app can back, dead buttons, and crash reporting were each checked against store policy

rules.reason: release not held at Gate-D and no approval id
no check defined on the real target
